description: This file is the full source code of the jQuery DataTables plugin, version 1.9.4. It provides functionalities such as paginating, searching, sorting, and dynamically manipulating HTML tables, and includes methods for initializing, updating, and rendering DataTables instances. It defines the core DataTable class, internal methods, and plugin extension points.

classes.name: DataTable
classes.description: The core class representing a data table instance with methods for initialization, data manipulation, rendering, and configuration.

methods.name: _fnAddColumn( oSettings, nTh )
methods.description: Adds a column with default options to the table during initialization.

methods.name: _fnColumnOptions
methods.description: Applies specific options to a particular column, such as type, visibility, and sorting.

methods.name: _fnAdjustColumnSizing( oSettings )
methods.description: Adjusts the column widths to fit the current data, intended to be called before a redraw.

methods.name: _fnVisibleToColumnIndex
methods.description: Converts a visible column index to the data array index, considering hidden columns.

methods.name: _fnColumnIndexToVisible
methods.description: Converts a data array index to the visible column index, considering hidden columns.

methods.name: _fnVisbleColumns
methods.description: Returns the count of visible columns in the table.

methods.name: _fnGetColumns
methods.description: Retrieves an array of column indices based on a specific property, such as visibility or searchability.

methods.name: _fnDetectType
methods.description: Detects the data type ('string', 'num', etc.) of a given data value.

methods.name: _fnReOrderIndex
methods.description: Reorders the internal index array based on column names for sorting purposes.

methods.name: _fnColumnOrdering
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated string of column names representing the current order.

methods.name: _fnApplyColumnDefs( oSettings, aoColDefs, aoCols, fn )
methods.description: Applies column definitions (such as classes or types) based on targets specified in configuration.

methods.name: _fnAddData( oSettings, aDataSupplied )
methods.description: Adds a data array as a new row to the table, creating DOM elements if necessary.

methods.name: _fnGatherData
methods.description: Reads data from the DOM table and populates internal data structures.

methods.name: _fnNodeToDataIndex
methods.description: Converts a row DOM node into an internal data index.

methods.name: _fnNodeToColumnIndex
methods.description: Converts a cell DOM node into a column data index.

methods.name: _fnGetRowData
methods.description: Returns an array of data for a specific row from the internal cache.

methods.name: _fnGetCellData
methods.description: Retrieves the data for a specific cell, considering custom get functions.

methods.name: _fnSetCellData
methods.description: Sets the data value for a specific cell in the cache.

methods.name: _fnGetObjectDataFn
methods.description: Creates a function to retrieve nested data from the data source based on a string path.

methods.name: _fnSetObjectDataFn
methods.description: Creates a function to set nested data into the data source based on a string path.

methods.name: _fnClearTable
methods.description: Clears all data and resets the internal state, preparing for new data load.

methods.name: _fnAjaxUpdate( oSettings )
methods.description: Performs an Ajax request to update data from the server and redraws the table.

methods.name: _fnAjaxUpdateDraw( oSettings, json )
methods.description: Processes server response data, reordering if necessary, and redraws the table.

methods.name: _fnBuildHead
methods.description: Builds the table header HTML based on column definitions and DOM headers.

methods.name: _fnDrawHead
methods.description: Draws or updates the table header, managing column visibility and layout.

methods.name: _fnDraw
methods.description: Redraws the table rows, handling pagination, filtering, and styling.

methods.name: _fnReDraw
methods.description: Triggers a complete redraw of the table based on current sort/filter state.

methods.name: _fnAddOptionsHtml( oSettings )
methods.description: Generates and inserts the HTML elements for table controls such as pagination, filtering, etc.

methods.name: _fnDetectHeader
methods.description: Inspects the table header DOM and creates a layout grid representing row/column span relationships.

methods.name: _fnGetUniqueThs
methods.description: Returns an array of unique TH elements for each column, considering header layout.

methods.name: _fnInitialise
methods.description: Initializes the data table, sets up DOM elements, and triggers server requests if needed.

methods.name: _fnInitComplete
methods.description: Marks table initialization as complete and triggers associated callbacks.

methods.name: _fnLanguageCompat
methods.description: Provides backwards compatibility for language options, mapping older parameters to newer ones.

methods.name: _fnUpdateInfo
methods.description: Updates the info display with current table state info.

methods.name: _fnInfoMacros
methods.description: Replaces macros in info strings with actual dynamic values.

methods.name: _fnInitialise
methods.description: Performs initial setup and configuration of the DataTable instance.

methods.name: _fnFeatureHtmlLength
methods.description: Creates the length changing control element.

methods.name: _fnCalculateEnd
methods.description: Calculates the last display index based on pagination and filtering.

methods.name: _fnPageChange
methods.description: Changes the current page based on specified action or page number.

methods.name: _fnProcessingDisplay
methods.description: Show or hide the processing indicator.

methods.name: _fnFeatureHtmlTable
methods.description: Wraps the table in scrolling divs if scrolling options are enabled.

methods.name: _fnScrollDraw
methods.description: Synchronizes the header, footer, and body sizes when scrolling, including infinite scroll logic.

methods.name: _fnApplyToChildren
methods.description: Applies a function uniformly to child nodes within array of DOM elements.

methods.name: _fnConvertToWidth
methods.description: Converts CSS width units to pixel values.

methods.name: _fnCalculateColumnWidths
methods.description: Calculates optimal widths for columns considering content, user settings, and scrollbars.

methods.name: _fnScrollingWidthAdjust
methods.description: Adjusts table width taking into account scrollbars and scroll settings.

methods.name: _fnGetWidestNode
methods.description: Gets the widest cell node in a column for sizing purposes.

methods.name: _fnGetMaxLenString
methods.description: Finds the index of the data row with the maximum string length in a column.

methods.name: _fnStringToCss
methods.description: Appends 'px' to numeric or pixel-less width strings.

methods.name: _fnScrollBarWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of the scrollbar in the current browser.

methods.name: _fnSort
methods.description: Performs multi-column sorting on the data set.

methods.name: _fnSortAttachListener
methods.description: Attaches click handlers to header nodes for sorting interaction.

methods.name: _fnSortingClasses
methods.description: Updates CSS classes on header cells based on active sorting state.

methods.name: DataTable.defaults.columns
methods.description: Default column options that can be provided during initialisation, including sorting, filtering, visibility, render functions, class names, etc.
